scripts.name: 06.06 Easel: Section 0 (Core Check - Obsidian Twilight)
scripts.description: Bracket fix: the canonical heading is "[0. Overall Core Check] (Core Invariants Checklist)" - the closing bracket sat inside capture 1 and rendered as "0. Overall Core Check]" whenever 06.29 had not yet consumed the full six-section chart. Capture 1 is now the bare heading, capture 2 the optional trailing annotation/remainder, and the brackets are consumed outside both. 06.29 still owns complete charts, so full-chart output is unchanged.

scripts.name: 06.07 Easel: Invariant Item (PASS)

scripts.name: 06.08 Easel: Invariant Item (WARN)
scripts.description: Renders warning or failing Easel audit rows, including the optional Act & Consequence check. Only emitted rows are styled; this rule never inserts an audit or activates a module.

scripts.name: 06.09 Easel: Invariant Item (N/A)
scripts.description: Renders inapplicable Easel audit rows, including the optional Act & Consequence check. Only emitted rows are styled; this rule never inserts an audit or activates a module.

scripts.name: 06.10 Easel: Subsection Header
scripts.description: Ordering fix: runs after 06.31 and 01.03, which wrap these labels in <span class="sola-ec-field"> or <span class="sola-field-label">. The optional wrapper-span prefix/suffix keeps the subheading reachable; previously this rule never fired and the parenthetical annotations (e.g. "(Max 2-3 seeds in active focus)") rendered as body copy. The label list still requires end-of-line after the label, so value forms like "Active Pressures: None" remain plain fields.
